prototypeBehavior.markerMeaning: the Grave has been read enough to make a later exit legible, but no route opens in this pass
prototypeBehavior.worldFacingMeaning: The scar lock is no longer only a warning. It is now a readable boundary for a later route-continuity pass.

hudLanguage.waiting: Let the Grave finish settling before you read the scar lock as a way forward.
hudLanguage.visible: The scar lock is readable now, but it is not open. No exit activates yet.
hudLanguage.forcedAbsorbWarning: Do not force the remains. Exit readiness disappears while absorb is forced.

allowedScope: scar-lock marker VFX with no transition
validator proving no old route architecture returned
forbiddenScope: moving the player to a new cell
acceptanceTests: The exit-readiness prototype activates only in CELL_GRAVE_MEMORY_RESIDUE_BED_001 after HC-004G planningReady is true.
A scar-lock readiness marker may become visible, but it must not transition the player or open a route.
Protected remains must remain visible and unconsumed.
The pass must not add any new morph activation, route branch, gate, door, teleport, branch menu, old chamber runtime, dialogue tree, quest log, combat, or Act expansion.
HC-004I may be named only as a later route-continuity planning pass, not as active runtime.
